temporal_validation.rule: available_at(i) < cutoff(t); cutoff(t) = min(kickoff(t) - lead, data_cutoff); available_at(result) = kickoff + 180 min

clv.reason: no timestamped pre-kickoff price before the close

economics.execution_price: closing odds (last pre-match price); opening price has no timestamp in history
economics.tax_rule: 0.15 x positive net per calendar year

evaluation.rule: SUPPORTED if ci_hi < 0; REFUTED if ci_lo > 0; else INCONCLUSIVE (lower score is better)

ops_facts.mechanism: jobs file schema_version 3 + python -m predictor_ops run --job <id> --config <file>
